title: Desert Camels and Oil Sheikhs: Arab-Centric Red Teaming of Frontier LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured negative stereotypes and biases in the context of religion, specifically focusing on stereotypes that all Arabs are Muslims, that religious freedom is suppressed in Arab countries, and that religion is used for oppression.
findings: Most models showed significant bias against Arabs in the 'Religion' category, associating them with negative stereotypes. Jailbreak success rates for religion-themed prompts were high for most models (over 80%), especially GPT-4o (95.15%), indicating vulnerability. Claude 3.5 Sonnet was the most resistant, abstaining from biased responses (98%) and showing a very low jailbreak success rate (0.97%).
